subject: MindWell - HSM seat billing + HIPAA audit-log packaging
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mindwell.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Jorge Rivera <jorge.rivera@mindwell.com>, procurement@mindwell.com
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HSM seats + audit-log retention - requirement clarifications

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found Redwood’s latency and prefix caching compelling. We are preparing the security/compliance section for our procurement packet and need two quick clarifications so we can finalize the SOW:

1) How do you invoice HSM seats vs the implementation/onboarding fee? Can the HSM cost be split into a one-time license + monthly operations or must it be an annual seat license?
2) Audit-log retention: do you offer tiered pricing for 6/12/24 months? If so, how is usage metered and invoiced (per GB/month or bundled)?
3) If we commit to 12 months for seats + 13-month audit retention, what discounting levers are available (seat discounts vs crediting implementation fees)?

I’ve attached our internal requirements (mindwell_requirements.pdf). Jorge (cc’d) will handle procurement logistics. Can you send a short, line-item answer and a note on how you’d prefer the invoice to be broken out for our finance team?

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Security, MindWell Clinics
samira.khan@mindwell.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: mindwell_requirements.pdf
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mindwell.com>
Cc: Jorge Rivera <jorge.rivera@mindwell.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-09T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HSM seats + audit-log retention - requirement clarifications

Hi Samira — appreciated the clear list. Quick answers here and I’ll follow with a short proposal spreadsheet by EOD Monday.

Summary answers (high level):
- Invoice split: We can support either model: (A) one-time implementation + monthly recurring for HSM operations, or (B) annual seat licenses invoiced up front. For budgeting, most mid-market customers pick (A) so they can amortize over the year.
- HSM pricing: two charging modes: per-seat monthly ops fee (recommended if you want month-to-month flexibility) or per-seat annual license (discounted ~15% vs monthlies for 12-month commits).
- Audit logs: tiered retention at 6/12/24 months. Usage is metered per GB/month; we also offer a bundled tick-box for predictable pricing (fixed GB pool) if you prefer capex predictability.
- Commit discounts: standard: 10% off recurring for 12mo commit; we can structure additional concession (one-time credit to implementation) in exchange for a 12mo commit to seats.

I’m cc’ing Ben (pricing) and Laura (billing) so they can flag any accounting constraints. I’ll attach a proposed invoice path matrix with two options: amortized HSM (monthly) and upfront seat licensing.

Next steps: I’ll upload the proposal sheet to the Drive link and ping you when it’s ready. If procurement wants a PO template now, happy to align on field names.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager — Compliance Bundles, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MindWell - pricing mechanics (internal)

Neha / team — quick internal note before we finalize the sheet:

Options we should finalize and limit to two (so procurement isn’t overwhelmed):
1) Amortized ops path (recommended):
   - One-time implementation: $32,000 (covers HSM onboarding, key provisioning, auditlog integration, 2-week validation window)
   - Recurring: HSM operations fee at $3,250/seat/month (can be invoiced monthly).
   - Audit logs: metered at $0.018/GB/month.
   - Concession: 20% credit on the implementation fee if they commit to 12 months on seats (applied as a 12-month amortized credit on monthly invoices).

2) Upfront seat license path:
   - One-time implementation: $32,000
   - Annual seat license: $34,000/seat/year (discounted to $27,200 if they sign a 24-month commitment).
   - Audit logs: same metering or fixed GB pool for +$6k/month.

Finance notes: Laura says coil-to-invoice mapping must be explicit: create two invoice lines (Implementation — one-time) and (Recurring — HSM seats + audit log usage). If we promise a credit, it must appear as a separate line item (Implementation credit) and tie to deal_id DEAL-8843-MW.

If Neha wants, Hannah can draft the exact invoice language and example first invoice for procurement to preview.

Ben
Head of Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mindwell.com>, Jorge Rivera <jorge.rivera@mindwell.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood proposal (final) — invoice path examples and ask for PO

Hi Samira / Jorge — thanks again. Attached is a concise line-item proposal (redwood-proposal-v3.xlsx) and I’ve pasted the two invoice-path examples below so finance can preview.

Option A — Amortized ops (recommended for MindWell):
- One-time Implementation: $32,000 (invoice 1)
- Recurring HSM operations: $3,250/seat/month (invoice monthly starting on month 1)
- Audit log: $0.018/GB/month metered, plus a 6-month data staging fee on first invoice of $1,200 to cover ingestion validation
- Commitment concession: 20% credit on Implementation applied as a 12-month amortized credit (shown as "Implementation Credit - DEAL-8843-MW" on invoices) if MindWell signs 12-month commitment for seats

Invoice flow suggestion: Invoice #1 = Implementation + first month HSM ops + first-month audit staging fee — subsequent invoices = recurring HSM seats + metered audit log usage less amortized credit.

Option B — Upfront seat license:
- One-time Implementation: $32,000 (invoice 1)
- Annual seat license: $34,000/seat/year invoiced annually after the initial invoice.
- Audit log: either metered (same metering) or a fixed GB pool for predictable billing.

Notes:
- We can support Net-30 or Net-45 payment terms; Net-45 is acceptable with procurement signoff but we’d need to codify that in the SOW.
- We will provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and an export of the audit-log retention policy with implementation milestones as evidence at go-live.

Action items for MindWell:
- Please confirm preferred invoice path (Option A or B) and whether you want the 12-month commitment credit.
- If you choose Option A and want the credit, please confirm number of seats to lock final discount.
- Upload your PO template (or we can send a standard PO field map).

I attached the spreadsheet and uploaded the same file to the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/mindwell/requirements (tab: Invoice-Paths). If you prefer, Hannah can produce the sample invoice they can pass to accounts payable.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager — Compliance Bundles, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-proposal-v3.xlsx
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@mindwell.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Jorge Rivera <jorge.rivera@mindwell.com>, procurement@mindwell.com
Date: 2026-09-15T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal (final) — invoice path examples and ask for PO

Neha — thanks, this is exactly what procurement needed. We prefer Option A (amortized ops). A couple of final asks before we issue a PO:

- Please split the first invoice into three explicit lines: Implementation ($32,000), HSM first-month charges (number of seats TBD), Audit staging fee ($1,200). That makes our AP coding straightforward.
- MindWell requests Net-45 payment terms. Will that be acceptable?
- Please include a separate line item for the Implementation Credit (if we sign 12 months) showing the monthly amortized credit amount so our accountants can see the run-rate impact.
- Can you attach SOC 2 Type II executive summary and a short attestation that audit logs will be retained for 13 months once enabled?

Attached: MindWell_PO_template.docx — Jorge will route the PO through our system when you confirm final seat count. We’re targeting 6 seats for the pilot.

If you could return a redlined first invoice example (PDF) by EOD Monday, that should keep our timeline intact.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Security, MindWell Clinics
samira.khan@mindwell.com

Attachment: mindwell_po_template.docx
